title: Quick Change
tagline: The bank job was easy. Leaving New York is hard.
about: Three bank robbers can't find their way out of New York.
cue: Serve the mains when the cabbie who speaks no English drives them nowhere.
faces: Breakfast, lunch, dinner and a late bar

    StartersStuffed Cherry TomatoesA dozen, filled with feta beaten smooth with basil, olive oil and lemon peel.A red nose for every guest.How to make it24 cherry tomatoes150g feta1 handful basil, plus 24 small leaves1 lemon, zested2 tbsp olive oilCut the tops off the tomatoes and scoop out the seeds.Blitz the feta with a handful of basil, the lemon zest and the oil until smooth.Pipe into the tomatoes and top each with a small basil leaf.Dynamite WingsOven-crisped, tossed in honey, butter, lime and sweet chilli sauce, with hot pepper flakes and coriander.Not as dangerous as they look.How to make it1kg chicken wings1 tsp baking powder1 tsp salt30g butter2 tbsp honey2 tbsp sweet chilli sauce1 tsp chilli flakes2 limes, zested and juiced1 handful corianderPat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and salt.Roast on a rack at 220°C, turning once, until crisp and cooked through.Melt the butter with the honey, sweet chilli sauce, chilli flakes, lime zest and juice.Toss the wings through and scatter with coriander.MainsTurkey & Swiss on a KaiserRoast breast, Swiss, iceberg, tomato, mayo and mustard. Wrapped to go.Wrapped to travel. You never know how long the trip takes.How to make it4 kaiser rolls80g mayonnaise1 tbsp yellow mustard400g sliced turkey8 slices of Swiss cheese1/2 iceberg lettuce, shredded2 tomatoes, slicedsalt and pepper, to tasteSplit the rolls and spread with mayonnaise and mustard.Fill with turkey, Swiss, lettuce and tomato and season.Wrap each tightly in paper and cut in half.SweetsClown CakeJam sponge under white buttercream, with a piped face and a cherry nose.Every kid gets a balloon.How to make it400g sponge cake100g raspberry jam200g butter, softened400g icing sugar1 drop food colouring1 maraschino cherrySplit the sponge and fill with jam.Beat the butter with the icing sugar and spread all over the cake.Tint a little buttercream with the food colouring and pipe a clown face on top.Press in the cherry for the nose.DrinksBourbon SmashBourbon shaken hard with fresh mint, lemon and sugar, over crushed ice.Last call 1:30 A.M.How to make it12 mint leaves, plus 4 sprigs1 lemon, cut into 4 wedges40ml sugar syrup180ml bourbon1 bag crushed iceMuddle the mint leaves and lemon wedges with the syrup in a shaker.Add the bourbon and ice and shake hard.Double strain into 4 glasses filled with crushed ice.Top with a sprig of mint and serve with short straws.
